**Newsletter opening (105 words)**

We believe that if superintelligent AI is built within the next 20 years, it will remain fully under human control. That conviction guides how we think about the choices ahead. The development of advanced AI is a human undertaking, and its direction is ours to shape. We can set priorities, establish safeguards and make decisions that keep people in charge. In this newsletter, we’ll share the ideas and actions that support that future, along with ways to take part. Our position is clear: powerful AI can be developed without surrendering control. We are working toward a future in which human judgment remains central, and we will keep building the support needed to make it real.
